html.content:
Recommended

Sankeyscore: 1.0

Flow diagram showing quantities moving between states or groups.

Clinical use: Patient disposition, treatment pathway flow

  • 2 cats as source/target + flow value

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='Sankey diagram of flow from <factor1> to <factor2>'

Alternatives

Alluvialscore: 1.0

Alluvial / Sankey-style flow diagram.

Clinical use: Patient pathway flow across study visits

  • 2+ cats + numeric → alluvial flow

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='alluvial diagram from <factor1> to <factor2>'

Stackedscore: 0.9

Stacked bars showing part-of-whole within each group.

Clinical use: AE severity breakdown per arm, disposition categories

  • 2+ categories ideal for stacking
  • few stack levels

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='stacked bar of <metric> by <category>'

Chordscore: 0.9

Circular chord diagram — pairwise flow between categories.

Clinical use: Cross-arm patient movement, co-medication flows

  • 2 cats + numeric → circular flow

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='chord diagram of flow between <factor1> and <factor2>'

StackedPercentscore: 0.85

100% stacked bars — each bar sums to 100%.

Clinical use: Relative AE severity distribution across arms

  • 2+ cats → proportion comparison
  • few stack segments

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='100% stacked bar of <metric> by <category>'
